premises.text: People buy brand clothes to show and talk about what they wear, not merely to own anonymous apparel
premises.evidence_span: They want to talk about them. They want others get to know what they have, what they wear

premises.text: Brand-in tagging on photos lets users declare brands they wear, analogous to Foursquare check-ins
premises.evidence_span: If you want, it's like in Foursquare, you check in places. In a tag brand, you brand in in brands

premises.text: iPhone app lets users ask the community what brand someone is wearing via question branding
premises.evidence_span: run our iPhone app and ask community what brand it is by making a question branding

premises.text: App polls of try-on photos get fast advice from friends and fashion experts to choose what to buy
premises.evidence_span: Take photos of yourself and create a poll. In less than a minute, you'll get a lot of advice from your friends, wife, lovers, and even fashion experts

premises.text: Web service unites brand-loyal users with tagging, wardrobes, wish lists, social Q&A, and bookmarklet tagging across sites
premises.evidence_span: a powerful web service which brings people together on the basis of their brand's loyalty

premises.text: Brands pay to communicate with fans (and competitors' fans); stores get a keyword-linked marketplace in branding areas
premises.evidence_span: brands can communicate with their fans and even with fans of their competitors. Brands will love it. And they will pay us for it

domains.name: brand-in, question branding, and choice polls

value.text: Dressed people can show brands, discover what others wear, and choose purchases with social fashion help
value.evidence_span: TechBrand is the service for dressed people only

secondary_value.text: Brands and stores monetize fan communication and linked commerce
secondary_value.evidence_span: And they will pay us for it
